items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Lewis Wade, he was another swim, what you call a pimp around that district. Yeah, he was a big time.

ctx.x: You missed your chance. You could have had another one. Well, what about Lewis Wade, did you know that?
Lewis Wade, he was another swim, what you call a pimp around that district. Yeah, he was a big time. Now, what about the piano player? Well, he played piano and he was good.
And his brother Clark or Clark or whatever you want to call him?
